client.name: Archipelago's SNI Client
client._source: bizhawk, decided 2026-08-19. The world's OWN client subclasses SNIClient -- that is upstream's transport, and the previous value recorded it. But the launcher never runs upstream's client: it has its own AP connection and its own RAM map, and Plugins/Scripts/games/alttp.lua is a BizHawk module that translates the SNI addresses to BizHawk domains itself. Proven live that day with A Link to the Past: 3 checks out, 6 items in. The sni extension carries the protocol but cannot drive a game -- its GetLaunchPlan returns null and nothing in the launcher calls its Read/Write -- so "sni" here meant a plugin that installs and then throws at launch.

patch._source: audit_patch_model.py read the world: C:\ProgramData\Archipelago\lib\worlds\alttp\Rom.pyc: class LttPDeltaPatch(APDeltaPatch), methods ['get_source_data']

_note: The accepted dump is the JAPANESE 1.0 ROM (constant LTTPJPN10HASH), not a US one -- the randomizer patches from that base. Two patch extensions: .aplttp and .apz3. AP game name is 'A Link to the Past', without the 'Legend of Zelda:' prefix.
